item.text:
- **Set a fair test:** Pick a few small tasks with answers you can verify, and give each peer the same instructions and deadline. This makes correctness comparable without consuming much of the hour.
- **Test more than once:** Send tasks in separate files and ask for answers before sharing other peers’ results. Repetition helps distinguish steady reliability from a lucky guess, though it costs time.
- **Verify and rank:** Check answers against known results; score correctness first, then timely completion and consistency. Keep the test short enough to leave time to read the replies.
